criteria.description: Suspected or confirmed allergic fungal rhinosinusitis or invasive fungal sinusitis

required_documentation: ENT examination notes, nasal endoscopy findings, or allergy/immunology testing demonstrating fungal sinusitis features
rules.review_notes: Complex complicated sinusitis indication evaluating bony sinus erosion and expansion.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Chronic rhinosinusitis (> 12 weeks duration) with ALL of the following

criteria.description: Chronic rhinosinusitis persisting for greater than 12 weeks duration
Failure of at least 4 weeks of maximal medical therapy including oral antibiotics and intranasal corticosteroids

required_documentation: ENT clinic notes documenting symptoms duration, failed medical therapy medications and dates, and nasal endoscopy
rules.review_notes: Sinus CT indicated for chronic rhinosinusitis after failed 4 weeks maximal medical therapy.
